codes.REC_ENDED: This schedule has ended, so there is nothing left to change or run.

recurring.title: Recurring invoices
recurring.subtitle: Schedules that make invoices by themselves, on the dates you set.

all.title: No recurring invoices yet
all.message: Set a schedule once and the invoice is made for you every week, month or year.

active.title: Nothing is running
active.message: Active schedules, the ones that will make their next invoice on time, appear here.

paused.title: No paused schedules
paused.message: A schedule you pause stops making invoices until you resume it.

ended.title: No ended schedules
ended.message: A schedule ends after its last run or its end date.

recurring.emptySearch: Nothing in the loaded rows matches. Clear the search or load more.

message.draft: This makes the invoice for {date} now, as a draft you can review, and the schedule moves on to the next period.
message.issue: This makes the invoice for {date} now and issues it (it gets its number at once). The schedule moves on to the next period.
message.issue_send: This makes the invoice for {date} now, issues it and sends it to the buyer. The schedule moves on to the next period.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.message: {name} stops making invoices. The invoices it already made stay in your list.

toast.resumedEnded: {name} had no periods left, so it has ended.
toast.runFailed: The run for {name} failed and was recorded. Open the history to see why.

draft.title: Leave as a draft
draft.hint: Each invoice waits for your review before it is issued.

issue.title: Issue it
issue.hint: Each invoice is numbered and ready the day it is due.

issue_send.title: Issue and send
issue_send.hint: Each invoice is issued and sent to the buyer on its own.

warnings.noBuyerEmail: There is no buyer email in the template, so an email send will fail. Add an email or send by link.

outcome.issue_email: Each invoice is issued and emailed to the buyer.
outcome.issue_link: Each invoice is issued and recorded as shared by link.
outcome.issue_whatsapp: Each invoice is issued and sent on WhatsApp.

preview.noRuns: No runs fall inside this schedule.

builder.endedNoEdit: This schedule has ended, so it can no longer be edited.
builder.newSubtitle: Set the rhythm and the invoice it makes. The next runs show on the side.
builder.editSubtitle: Change the rhythm or the invoice for the periods still to come.
builder.conflict: Someone else changed this schedule while you were editing. Reload to see their version. Your edits here will be lost.
builder.created: {name} will now make invoices on schedule.
builder.name: Name
builder.nameHint: Only you see it, for example Monthly retainer.
builder.startFixed: The start date cannot be changed. Create a new schedule to start from another date.
builder.startHint: A date in the past makes the periods already due right away, up to 12.
builder.endHint: No invoice is made after this date.
builder.maxRunsHint: The schedule ends after this many invoices.
builder.scheduleEditNote: A changed rhythm continues from today and never repeats a period that already ran.
builder.sendChannelHint: Link records that you share the link yourself. Email and WhatsApp send it for you.
builder.templateFuture: A new template applies to the invoices still to come. Invoices already made are not changed.

template.title: Invoice template
template.hint: Every period gets a new invoice made from this one, dated for that period.

invoice.title: Copy an invoice
invoice.hint: Use the buyer and lines of an invoice you already made.

build.title: Build a template

template.copyOf: A copy of this invoice, totalling

template.startFromInvoiceHint: Loads its buyer and lines here so you can adjust them.

template.buyerCountryHint: Two letters, like IN or DE.

template.paymentTermsHint: Counted from the day each invoice is issued.
